# Maison Plush Paris

> Maison Plush Paris is a French fashion and lifestyle brand offering limited-edition fashion, accessories and body-care products.

Maison Plush operates an online store in English and French.

## Shop

- [Shop](https://maison-plush.com/shop): Browse currently available products.
- [Collections](https://maison-plush.com/collections): Browse Maison Plush collections.

- [Contact](https://maison-plush.com/contact): Contact Maison Plush Paris.
